surface: Complete against react-syntax-highlighter 16.1.1: default, Light, Prism, async and async-light components; static registration and language lists; custom renderers and tags; all pinned Highlight.js and Prism languages and styles; and all ESM/CJS deep-import aliases.
divergences: PreTag and CodeTag accept native tag names or Octane function components. React class components require a function adapter because React instance identity is renderer-owned.
ssr: Synchronous variants emit highlighted server HTML without DOM globals. Async variants emit the same deterministic plain-code fallback and hydrate by adopting the existing pre, code, and token nodes before live updates.
